## Activity

During February 2023, Central Eye Clinic recorded 173 captures. This figure represents the activity reported for the month and provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures below. The activity total is presented without adjustment or extrapolation.

## Image quality

Of the 173 captures, 4 were marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.3. This measure indicates the proportion of captures that could not be assessed for grading purposes. The image quality result is reported alongside the total capture activity to provide the relevant monthly context.

## Grading

A total of 40 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 2. This records the central grading turnaround for the month. Together, the referable result count and median lag summarise the grading outcome and timeliness reported for Central Eye Clinic in February 2023.
